summary: Konami's 1987 vehicular-combat arcade driving game about a getaway car escaping enemies and police through checkpoint-based stages.

entries.title: City Bomber
entries.definitive_edition: Original arcade release / Arcade Archives for modern official access

emulation.notes: MAME is the preservation route for the original arcade game; Arcade Archives provides modern official access on PlayStation 4 and Nintendo Switch.
emulation.fidelity_ceiling: Original Konami GX400 arcade presentation with modern scaling

primary.why: City Bomber was developed and released as an arcade game on Konami GX400 hardware. Later Xbox 360/Windows Game Room and Arcade Archives releases are emulated access routes, while the original arcade version remains the source and primary presentation.
primary.how_to_play: Play the arcade version in MAME/original hardware; Arcade Archives on PlayStation 4 or Nintendo Switch is the modern official route.

entries.remaster_caveats: Game Room and Arcade Archives are emulated re-releases rather than remasters.
